changes_to_sapphire_rtl: RAM optimization copy: on-chip program RAM reduced from 32 KiB to 16 KiB; byte-lane depths 8192 -> 4096, word address width 13 -> 12, and BmbDecoder_2 range mask 0x7fff -> 0x3fff. CPU, caches, peripherals and clocks unchanged. RAM initialization files contain our compiled program.
original_settings_note: sapphire_original_settings.json describes the original generator configuration; this copy applies the bounded RAM edit to the generated RTL directly, with matching linker/init files and real-CPU simulation. Regenerating Sapphire requires applying the 16 KiB setting again.
